snippet.title: CONTROL Resonant – Paranatural Manhattan Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
The Oldest House has fallen. Reality is bent. Time is warping.

CONTROL Resonant features an open-ended, imaginative sandbox. Experience the largest and richest environment Remedy has ever constructed for a game in this new trailer, showing the visual diversity of paranaturally twisted Manahattan and its enemy factions.

The trailer features the original song Manalan Mailla by Vilma Jää, available wherever you listen to good music.

CONTROL Resonant arrives September 24th 2026 to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, and Mac via Steam and the App Store. Pre-order now!

PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017682/ 
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p092299fsgw
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669870/CONTROL_Resonant/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/control-resonant-3568d3

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment. 

Find out more at https://controlgame.com/
